mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plugin_runtime ( plugin_id, instance_id, version, display_name, main_class, artifact_path, artifact_sha256, runtime_type, state, capabilities_json, config_schema_json, account_schema_json, dependency_jars_json ) VALUES ( #{pluginId}, #{instanceId}, #{version}, #{displayName}, #{mainClass}, #{artifactPath}, #{artifactSha256}, 'process', 'STOPPED', CAST(#{capabilitiesJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{configSchemaJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{accountSchemaJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{dependencyJarsJson} AS JSON) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE instance_id = VALUES(instance_id), version = VALUES(version), display_name = VALUES(display_name), main_class = VALUES(main_class), artifact_path = VALUES(artifact_path), artifact_sha256 = VALUES(artifact_sha256), runtime_type = VALUES(runtime_type), state = 'STOPPED', runner_port = NULL, started_at = NULL, capabilities_json = VALUES(capabilities_json), config_schema_json = VALUES(config_schema_json), account_schema_json = VALUES(account_schema_json), dependency_jars_json = CASE WHEN #{overwriteDependencies} THEN VALUES(dependency_jars_json) ELSE dependency_jars_json END
